blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawmakers from the House of Representatives’ so-called Young Guns bloc have maintained that true peace will not be attained if one side makes threats — in response to Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan’s statements that China can easily win through military power but seeks a peaceful resolution. In a statement on Friday, Young Guns members Deputy Speakers Paolo Ortega V and Jefferson Khonghun, along with Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong, Manila Rep. Ernix Dionisio, claimed that Jing’s statements carry a threat and does not signify an assurance of peace. “Threat is not an assurance of peace. When a […]...
